scenes.setting: Shooting Club after lunch: revolver practice that has finally earned Dunn's basic approval
scenes.text_anchor: After eating lunch, Klein only rested for half an hour

scenes.setting: Gawain's training field: Klein's special-forces pitch about combat plus guns shakes the stern old teacher — who answers with ten more sets, then covers his face
scenes.text_anchor: After practicing for a while, he put away his revolver

scenes.setting: Evil Dragon Bar underground market at dusk: Ademisaul is missing and raving of corpses; Beyonder ingredient prices crush 'the poorest boss among secret organizations'
scenes.text_anchor: After nearly puking from exhaustion, Klein took a shower

scenes.setting: Market exit: Old Neil arrives — then Swain, reeking of alcohol, asks their help: a Mandated Punisher has lost control nearby
scenes.text_anchor: Just then, he saw Old Neil in his classic black robe entering slowly.
